title: Restriction, recorded forgetting and finite evaluation
statement: Let T be a scheme, R and A towers of sheaves of commutative rings, phi the associated sequence-site ring map, F a Forget structure for R [def-sp-tower-class-systems], and n a natural number. Restricting an A-system along phi, applying F and evaluating at n is naturally isomorphic to evaluating the A-system at n and forgetting its finite coefficient action. Components identify each forgotten section with the same actual module section. The specialized comparison for Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern] is finiteScalarForgetIso. The transport and section lemmas express equality elimination and the section and morphism fields of F.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: At each chart use the equality F.sections to form an identity-transport additive isomorphism. The restriction field makes the components natural on the site, so they form a sheaf isomorphism.
The morphism field of F makes these sheaf isomorphisms natural in the A-system. Restriction changes only the scalar action, so the underlying additive maps agree.
The section formulas follow by equality elimination. Applying the heterogeneous morphism equality to corresponding sections yields the map-on-sections formula.
